messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: html
parts:
Somewhere in your ui.R definition:

tags$style(type="text/css", "body { background-image: url(your-url-here); }")

If you want to use a png file or whatever that isn't already on the web, put the file in a "www" subdirectory of your app dir, then just put the filename (including extension, but not including "www") in the url() in the line above.
